title: BotDeskLeaseCreateRequest
description: bot.desk-lease-create-request@1 (the Desks plan's D6): the body of POST /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases on OpenVibe.Bot (capability bot.desk.session), answered 201 with bot.desk-lease@1. DESK is the name Run chose for the session (unique per session); a desk already leased to another session, or running for the machine's owner, is refused 409 bot.desk_busy, and a repeat for the same session answers its lease (200). A machine with no room (its max_desks) is refused 409 bot.machine_busy, one that is offline 409 bot.device_offline, and one the person may not use 404 bot.device_not_found.
